answer: The kernel explorer shows the whole merge tree. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the anchor binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. A 405 account operation therefore ties up 35 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
